criteria.natural: Orang China daratan sungguhan bilang begini? (dalam batas ±300 kata HSK 1)
criteria.clarity: Konteks jelas untuk pemula; terjemahan cocok
criteria.flow: Tiap baris menjawab baris sebelumnya; tujuan & penutup jelas

reviews.comment: Natural farewell. Grandma's thanks comes slightly out of nowhere (no reason for thanking is shown), but plausible at pick-up.
A shopkeeper calling a young student customer 先生 and using 您 sounds stiff; 'Sir! Sir!' is textbook. Seller never names the item, relies on gesture.
reviews.suggestion: Seller: 同学！同学！ (near campus) or 哎！你的手机！ then 这是你的吧？ Keep 谢谢 / 不客气.

reviews.comment: Dad answering 三个 then Mom correcting is odd: he knows Grandpa is parking, and nothing in the dialog tells the learner who the fourth person is (only the situation text). Waiter 您好 rendered as 'Selamat datang' (more like 欢迎光临) - small mismatch.
reviews.suggestion: Dad: 三个……不，四个。爷爷在停车。 (or Mom: 四个，还有爷爷。) so the reason is audible; or make Dad say 四个 directly and keep the humor out.

cmn: 没有吗？……在这儿呢，这些都是。
reviews.comment: Asking 有牛奶吗 rather than 牛奶在哪儿 does not match the stated goal (finding where it is). Seller pointing the wrong way and then discovering it is right here is contrived, and 这些都是 is vague.
reviews.suggestion: Mom: 请问，牛奶在哪儿？ Seller: 在那边。 Mom: 那边没有…… Seller: 哦，在这儿！ Mom: 谢谢！ Or keep 有牛奶吗 and drop the failed pointing.

reviews.comment: Lively and believable. 它 stays ambiguous until Grandpa asks 它？ (translations supply 'cat'); fine because the situation names the cat.

cmn: 饺子好了！二十个，怎么样？
reviews.comment: Fun and realistic grandma-feeding scene. Counting dumplings by number rather than a bowl is slightly unusual but works at this level.
Very natural family exchange, good comic ending with 妈！
Cute and natural. Ending 真的吗？ is a bit weak/open. Indonesian 'Namanya siapa?' for a pet is acceptable ('Namanya apa?' is more neutral).

cmn: 包子没有了。有饺子和面条儿。
reviews.comment: Good ordering flow. 不喝了 implies 'stop drinking'; the usual refusal is 不喝，谢谢 / 不用了. 面条儿 with erhua is northern flavour, 面条 is safer. Waiter 您好 rendered 'Selamat siang' (time not in the Chinese).
reviews.suggestion: Mom: 不喝，谢谢。 Waiter: ……面条。

cmn: 今天不是星期六，是星期五！
星期五？昨天不是星期五吗？
星期四……对，对。那明天是星期六。
reviews.comment: Clear, funny, good day-of-week practice. 你还上学？ is a little clipped; 你怎么还上学？ / 你还要上学？ is more natural.

Mostly natural. 下午也好 is slightly off (下午可以 / 下午行). 上午没有 is terse (上午没时间). 不见不散 is a bit old-fashioned/textbook for students. Study plan is only in the situation text. EN 'I'll be there!' vs ID 'Pokoknya ketemu' differ slightly.
Realistic street-asking with natural repeat-and-clarify (前头哪儿？) and a clear landmark.

Mom asks whether the cinema is up ahead although she is the one who named it as the destination; plausible only if she does not know the area. Taxi drivers usually don't open with 您好. No payment before getting out (多少钱 missing), so the ending feels unfinished. 您好 rendered 'Selamat siang'.
reviews.suggestion: Mom: 前头堵车了？还远吗？ Driver: 不远，电影院就在前头。 Mom: 那我在这儿下车吧。多少钱？ Driver: 十八块。 (or end with 谢谢 + 慢走).

cmn: 今天星期六……我再睡一下。
reviews.comment: Very believable. 再睡一下 should be 再睡一会儿 (睡一下 is odd). Otherwise good.

cmn: 喂，我在超市。晚上想吃什么？
reviews.comment: Natural phone call and family banter.

cmn: 新同桌？男孩子还是女孩子？
学霸？那你也要好好学习。
reviews.comment: Natural, nice mom-child exchange. 很好 vs Indonesian 'Seru' differ slightly in tone; 我有一个新同桌 is OK but 我换了新同桌 / 来了一个新同桌 is more idiomatic. 学霸 is slang (outside HSK 1) but suits a child.

cmn: 你妈妈写的什么？字太小了，我看不见。
我看看……她说她今天晚上八点回来。
reviews.comment: 我看不见 is wrong for 'can't read small text': that means totally unable to see; should be 看不清. Also ID 'Tulis: baik' does not match 知道了 ('got it'). 写 for replying to a message is understandable but 回 is more natural.
reviews.suggestion: Grandpa: 你妈妈写的什么？字太小了，我看不清。 ... 好。你回：知道了。 Fix ID to 'Tulis: tahu/siap'.

cmn: 两三点？你要多休息，不要熬夜了。
reviews.comment: Doctor jumps straight to sleep time with no symptom given beyond 难受; a doctor would first ask where it hurts or what is wrong. Title also gives away the answer.
reviews.suggestion: Big brother: 医生，我头疼，也很累。 Doctor: 晚上几点睡觉？ (add a concrete symptom before the sleep question).

cmn: 便宜一点儿吧，我买五个。
reviews.comment: Realistic bargaining and 扫码 touch. Apples are normally sold per 斤 (五块一斤); 五块一个 is possible but unusual. 老板 translated as 'Bu' while a neutral 'Pak/Bu penjual' fits better.

cmn: 看电影？你看了一个小时了！
好看也明天再看。现在睡觉！
reviews.comment: Natural parent-child exchange; good escalation and resolution.

是新的 is odd from a shop assistant (sounds like 'not used'); EN/ID render it as 'new in / baru datang', which the Chinese does not say. Seller says 看 where 试 is expected; Mom says 有点儿大 right after being offered to try, skipping the trying step.
reviews.suggestion: Seller: 这是新的。您试试？ -> better 这是新款。您试试吧？ ; later 您试试这件。 Then Mom: 有点儿大……

reviews.comment: Much better: 同学！你的手机！ is what a shopkeeper would shout. Minor: 是不是你的？ right after 你的手机！ is slightly redundant (seller already said it is his), and the big brother's 我的手机？ makes the loop a bit circular. Acceptable with a gesture.
Fixed well. Dad miscounting, little sister's 我呢？ and 四个，四个！ is natural, funny and self-explanatory; the reason for 'four' is now audible.
Clean and realistic: 牛奶在哪儿？ matches the goal, the answer is concrete, repeat-and-confirm is natural.

cmn: 好。……前头堵车了。电影院在那儿。
那我在这儿下车吧。多少钱？
reviews.comment: Now complete: destination, jam, getting out, price, payment, 慢走. 在那儿 relies on a gesture (clear from the situation). Translation: 好。谢谢师傅！ is rendered 'Here you go. Thank you!' / 'Ini.' which the Chinese does not say; use 'OK. Thanks!' / 'Oke. Terima kasih, Pak!'.

cmn: 你妈妈写的什么？字太小了，你读一下。
我看看……她说她今天晚上八点回来。
reviews.comment: 看不见 problem is gone and 回/回了 are natural. 你读一下 is a little curt/stiff from a grandfather; 你读给我听 / 你念一下 is more natural, minor. ID 'oke, siap' for 知道了 is a slightly different tone but fine.

cmn: 医生，我这几天有点儿难受，不想吃饭。
你要多休息，不要熬夜了。
reviews.comment: Good now: symptom first, then sleep, then the reason (打工), then advice. 你在做什么？ is a bit vague as a doctor's question (你晚上做什么？ is clearer) but acceptable; ID 'ada keluhan apa' is more formal than 怎么了, minor.

cmn: 嗯……有点儿大。有小一点儿的吗？
reviews.comment: 是新的 gone; the try-on is now acknowledged. 穿一下看看 is a workable substitute for 试 given the vocabulary limit. The try-on happens off-stage, so the learner depends on the situation text and the added '(after trying it on)' note in the translations to follow the jump to 有点儿大.
